definition: When a [player](/term/player) tries to deceive their opponent to make them take an action. The act of baiting can be done on multiple scales. On a [skirmishing](/term/skirmish) level, a player can bait to try to get an opponent to start a [fight](/term/fight), only to have their teammate(s) join once the opponents have committed to the fight. On a smaller scale, weaving in and out of the maximum range of an opponent's ability can maximize the chances of their opponent wasting a skillshot.
